purpose: Engineering evidence and decisions; claims are paraphrases, not normative quotations

sources.title: Agent Skills format specification
sources.finding: SKILL.md and portable metadata are the minimum skill contract
sources.engineering_implication: Validate directory/name/description and references; distinguish strict format from policy

sources.title: OpenAI Build Skills
sources.finding: Skills should be focused; descriptions control implicit matching
sources.engineering_implication: Require trigger and negative-trigger examples; retain optional OpenAI metadata

sources.title: OpenAI Codex customization
sources.finding: AGENTS.md and SKILL.md serve distinct roles; Codex finds repo skills in .agents/skills
sources.engineering_implication: Use repo policy separately from the skill entrypoint

sources.title: OpenAI Plugins Skills
sources.finding: MCP tools expose capabilities while skills encode workflows
sources.engineering_implication: Do not confuse repository skills with connectors or remote execution

sources.title: VS Code Agent Skills
sources.finding: Clients may discover several skill directories
sources.engineering_implication: Use canonical .agents/skills; validate client-specific installation instead of assuming equivalence

sources.title: OpenAI Codex engineering workflows
sources.finding: AGENTS.md can contain durable repository operating instructions
sources.engineering_implication: Keep acceptance gates and phased planning versioned

sources.title: OpenAI Skills old catalog README
sources.finding: The old catalog now directs readers to newer plugin guidance
sources.engineering_implication: Do not base current installations on obsolete catalog instructions

sources.title: OpenAI prompt injection safety
sources.finding: Untrusted content can redirect an agent toward unintended actions
sources.engineering_implication: Constrain scopes, obtain confirmation, and avoid broad tool authority

sources.title: OpenAI agent builder safety
sources.finding: Use tool approvals, constrained inputs, and trace evaluations
sources.engineering_implication: Add adversarial and side-effect tests before release

sources.title: GitHub secure your organization
sources.finding: Workflows should minimize token permissions and pin external actions
sources.engineering_implication: Use read-only permission and no external Actions in bootstrap CI

sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
sources.finding: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage give risk-program structure
sources.engineering_implication: Map assurance gates to governance, measurement, and risk response

sources.title: MCP Skills Extension specification
sources.finding: MCP-served skill text is untrusted and local execution requires approval
sources.engineering_implication: Do not assume remotely supplied skills grant execution authority

sources.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
sources.authors: Long Ouyang, John Schulman, Paul Christiano et al.
sources.finding: Demonstrations plus preference ranking can align model outputs with user goals.
sources.engineering_implication: Specify supervised feedback and preference datasets independently of skill files; version annotator rubrics.

provision_audit.finding: SFT demonstrations, preference rankings, then RLHF
provision_audit.provision: Separate demonstrations and preference pairs, record annotator criteria
provision_audit.caveat: Model training, not a SKILL.md capability
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization
sources.authors: Rafael Rafailov, Chelsea Finn, Christopher Manning et al.
sources.finding: Directly optimize preference likelihood without a separately trained reward model.
sources.engineering_implication: Treat DPO as an optional model-training workflow, not a property of a markdown skill.

provision_audit.finding: DPO optimizes chosen/rejected data against a reference policy
provision_audit.provision: Version pairs, reference model and training objective
provision_audit.caveat: Requires weight optimization and curated preferences
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
sources.authors: Yuntao Bai, Amanda Askell et al.
sources.finding: Critique and preference generation from explicit principles can provide scalable AI feedback.
sources.engineering_implication: Store policy version, critique provenance and human auditing for AI-generated feedback.

provision_audit.finding: Constitutional critique, revision and AI preference training
provision_audit.provision: Version principles, critiques, preference source and human audits
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
sources.authors: Aman Madaan, Niket Tandon, Sean Welleck et al.
sources.finding: Iterated self-critique and revision can improve outputs without weight updates.
sources.engineering_implication: Add bounded generate-critique-revise loop with external acceptance tests and stopping rules.

provision_audit.provision: Bound retries, enforce independent correctness checks
provision_audit.caveat: Critique is not guaranteed to improve output
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
sources.authors: Noah Shinn, Shunyu Yao, Karthik Narasimhan et al.
sources.finding: Verbal reflection can inform future trials via episodic memory without parameter optimization.
sources.engineering_implication: Use scoped, expiring memory records and measure retries against a no-memory baseline.

provision_audit.finding: Verbal feedback stored as episodic memory
provision_audit.provision: Version and expire reflections, run no-memory baseline
provision_audit.caveat: Memory is not neural reinforcement learning
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls
sources.authors: Omar Khattab, Matei Zaharia, Christopher Potts et al.
sources.finding: Modular LM programs can optimize instructions and demonstrations against a metric.
sources.engineering_implication: Separate skill behavior contracts from optimizable prompt variants; evaluate before promotion.

provision_audit.finding: Optimize LM programs against declared metrics
provision_audit.provision: Version prompts and demonstrations, keep untouched holdout
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance
sources.authors: Lingjiao Chen, Matei Zaharia, James Zou
sources.finding: Cascades can route easy tasks to cheaper models and reserve expensive calls for failures.
sources.engineering_implication: Benchmark candidate model tiers and escalation against quality, latency and cost ceilings.

provision_audit.finding: Cascades trade cost against answer quality
provision_audit.provision: Compare strong-only baseline against bounded cascade
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs from Preference Data
sources.authors: Isaac Ong, Amjad Almahairi, Ion Stoica et al.
sources.finding: Preference-informed routers can balance model quality and inference expenditure.
sources.engineering_implication: Log router decisions and confidence; compare against a fixed strong-model baseline.

provision_audit.finding: Preference-trained model router chooses between model tiers
provision_audit.provision: Calibrate routing, log confidence and escalation
provision_audit.caveat: Transfer results not a new-provider guarantee
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
sources.authors: Lianmin Zheng, Wei-Lin Chiang, Ion Stoica et al.
sources.finding: Model judges are scalable but can suffer position, verbosity, and self-preference biases.
sources.engineering_implication: Randomize response order; use blinded human calibration and independent judge models.

provision_audit.finding: LLM judges show order and verbosity biases
provision_audit.provision: Use order swaps, blinded human audit, judge disagreement
provision_audit.caveat: Judge ratings are not ground truth
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Language Modeling
sources.authors: Nathan Lambert, Valentina Pyatkin, Hannaneh Hajishirzi et al.
sources.finding: Reward models require dedicated evaluation of preference discrimination.
sources.engineering_implication: Test preference judges on hard negatives and out-of-domain cases before use.

provision_audit.finding: Reward model evaluation uses chosen/rejected contrasts
provision_audit.provision: Include hard negatives and safety/reasoning subsets
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-world Github Issues?
sources.authors: Carlos E. Jimenez, John Yang, Karthik Narasimhan et al.
sources.finding: Executable repository issue resolution gives stronger evidence than response-only grading.
sources.engineering_implication: Use isolated fixtures with fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass checks; do not equate benchmark score with production safety.

provision_audit.finding: Repository issues can be evaluated with executable tests
provision_audit.provision: Isolate patch cases and run regression and repair tests
provision_audit.caveat: Benchmark passes do not equal deployment readiness
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.authors: Nelson F. Liu, Percy Liang et al.
sources.finding: Relevant information in the middle of long prompts may be harder to retrieve.
sources.engineering_implication: Keep skill entrypoints short and test critical instructions at multiple context positions.

provision_audit.finding: Long-context extraction degrades at some positions
provision_audit.provision: Test instruction position and progressive loading
provision_audit.scope: publisher abstract / publication metadata; not reproduced experiment
